title: Security Deposit Return Guidelines under Model Tenancy Act
authority: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (Delhi State Rent Guidelines)
content: According to Chapter IV of the Model Tenancy Act, the security deposit to be paid by the tenant in advance shall: (a) not exceed two months' rent in case of residential premises; and (b) not exceed six months' rent in case of non-residential premises. The security deposit shall be refunded to the tenant by the landlord at the time of taking over vacant possession of the premises, after making due deduction of any liability of the tenant (such as unpaid rent, utility bills, or cost of repairing tenant-caused structural damage). If the landlord fails to refund the security deposit or make adjustments within 30 days of the tenant vacating the premises, the tenant has the right to file a dispute petition before the Rent Authority or Rent Tribunal.
